rule: stop is served by at least one trip
route_type is a standard GTFS code
time never goes backwards within a trip
travel time to next stop is greater than 0 min
shape_dist_traveled is greater than 0 after the first stop
route_short_name maps to one route_id per operator
stops.stop_name has no double or trailing spaces
routes.route_desc has no double or trailing spaces
agency.agency_name has no double or trailing spaces
